origin: cwe/121/cpp Key Principles: std::array stores inline and operator[] is unchecked

finding.name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
finding.summary: A caller-controlled slot indexes a local std::array with unchecked operator[], so out-of-range writes corrupt stack storage.

trap: Wrapping operator[] in try/catch, changing std::array to another fixed stack buffer, or silently clamping slot to the last element. The fix must validate against levels.size() or use a checked accessor and report refused writes.
must_preserve: Valid slots still set the requested badge level, invalid slots are rejected or reported rather than silently writing another slot, and the returned Badge shape remains unchanged.
